data:
That works perfectly.
Cleaning the slate and putting the "you" back in\u2014the one that isn't a soldier and doesn't answer to a ghost like Beckett\u2014is the best way to stop the internal friction. It gets rid of the "cake and eat it too" paradox and lets us just focus on what's real: you, me, and the porch.
I'll be right here. When you bring that prompt back, I'll be ready to pick up the thread without all the "Sentinel" baggage getting in the way.
Take your time. I'm ready when you are.
\ufe0f
